note: v50.7 - Per-page 'current market analysis' text now live-syncs with data. Existing narrative generators (breadth consensus, themes cycle, signal scenario/regime, macro scenario, options strategy rec, briefing action, sentiment VIX-term) were extracted into named functions and registered in AIO_PAGE_NARRATIVE_RENDERERS. A new AIO.refreshActivePageNarratives() re-runs the visible page's analysis text on aio:liveQuotes (every quote tick) and aio:refresh:done — not just on page-enter — with an 8s throttle and active-page guard. Each analysis area shows a '🔄 자동 갱신 · HH:MM:SS' stamp so users see the text updating in lockstep with the data. T769 added.
